newsitem.title: USA: Ameritrade Holding files for IPO to raise $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ameritrade Holding files for IPO to raise $50 mln.

text.p: Ameritrade Holding Corp on Monday filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the initial public offering of Class A common stock intended to raise up to $50 million.
The Omaha, Nebraska-based discount securities brokerage did not specify how many shares it would offer or estimate the price the company and certain of its stockholders would sell them.
It said it would use net proceeds to retire debt, to expand its customer base through marketing and for other corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through CS First Boston and Raymond James Associates, it said.
